gen-gf-unica-one-gf-epunda-slab: Stark and monoline: Unica One draws every stroke at a single thickness, with daylight showing inside each curve. Epunda Slab carries paragraphs gracefully on its rounded, tall lowercase and gaping c.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One speaks in a literary hush, with shallow ascenders. Its single best trick is Unica One, whose pen line holds one width throughout, a stark foil to that quiet serif.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-glegoo: Unica One draws a lowercase n whose arch and stem match, with daylight inside every curve. Glegoo comes in beneath it with big counters and wide, unclosed curves, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-piazzolla: Gaps and swagger: Wallpoet lets paper show through its lines and sends its lowercase high. But Piazzolla stays authoritative, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its e opened wide.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-scope-one: Scope One lets its counters spill into the surrounding space, with stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. Wallpoet above it is all bold, high-rising lowercase and gaps of paper, so the two speak in clearly different voices.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified Suwannaphum keeps a c as open as a bent paperclip. Beneath the bold Wallpoet heading, that high, squared-off x-height carries long paragraphs with a quietly unhurried editorial ease.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-epunda-slab: Ink-drawn and spacious: Warnes tapers its strokes out before they touch, with no contrast at all. Epunda Slab steadies it with a visibly gaping c and tall, rounded lowercase.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-fauna-one: Expressive Warnes keeps its lines the same width through every turn. Fauna One, a literary serif with a tall middle band, sits quietly underneath, its shallow ascenders and descenders giving the loud heading room.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-hanuman: Spacious and inky: Warnes never thins its curves at the turns. It earns its keep big and short, while Hanuman, refined and high-waisted, with wide-set terminals on s, handles the rest.
gen-irish-grover-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One carries a dignified hush, with shallow ascenders. Irish Grover is best at big, sturdy words with rounded sides that thicken slightly, while Fauna One is best at quiet literary reading.
